source: Beginner short story written in spoken Israeli Hebrew by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.en: Every morning I get up at seven.
I go to the kitchen and make coffee.

sentences.ar: אני אוהב קפה שחור, בלי סוכר.
sentences.en: I like black coffee, without sugar.

sentences.ar: אני יושב ליד החלון ושותה לאט.
sentences.en: I sit by the window and drink slowly.
Outside there's sun and the street is quiet.

sentences.ar: אחר כך אני מתלבש והולך לעבודה.
sentences.en: Afterwards I get dressed and go to work.
